column1: !!SBtab TableID='ConfigurePB' TableType='Config' SBtabVersion='1.2' Method='parameter-balancing' TableName='Default options of Parameter balancing (Matlab)'
% Default options of the Matlab implementation, assembled from parameter_balancing_options.m (parameter-balancing-matlab).
% Empty values: option is empty by default ([] in Matlab); vector-valued options are
% described in the column !Description. Flags: 1 (true) or 0 (false).
% Option names are case-sensitive. Options file used by the Matlab function parameter_balancing
% (columns !ID or !Option, and !Value). The file config/pb_options.tsv of the Matlab package contains
% the options of the Python version (ph, temperature, ...), which the Matlab version does not use.
